power.method: Existing AGRONA POWER loader; field centroid on the source grid

upstream.title: NASA/POWER Source Native Resolution Daily Data

soilgrids.method: Area-weighted overlap with valid cells on the native grid
soilgrids.limitations: Model estimate. Pixel range describes variability and does not represent prediction uncertainty.

imerg-power.method: Field centroid sampled on the source grid

upstream.title: NASA/POWER Source Native Resolution Daily Data

srtm.method: NASA HGT, field overlap weighted in the source geographic grid; elevation only

smap.reason: No recommended-quality SMAP morning data in up to eight inspected days
smap.method: Regional surface moisture, morning pass, QA bits 0–1 clear
smap.scope: At most eight days inspected, stops after three usable values

hls.method: Existing HLS worker, field window and Fmask QA
hls.scope: Up to five scenes inspected per product, stops after first usable scene

ecostress.method: Instantaneous land-surface temperature, clear land pixels with mandatory QC bits 00
ecostress.scope: Up to seven scenes inspected, stops at first usable scene

sentinel2.method: Scene Classification Layer at polygon cell centres; class 4 vegetation and 5 bare soil

fao-calendar.reason: FAO Crop Calendar has no records for KZ

modis.method: Centroid pixel from original composite; good pixel-reliability class

gaez.dataset: FAO/IIASA GAEZ v5 RES05-SIX, AgERA5 historical
gaez.method: Centroid raster cell; modeled regional suitability under stated management

viirs.method: Centroid pixel from original composite; best pixel-reliability class

imerg-final.method: Daily mean precipitation rate in the native grid cell at the field centre
imerg-final.scope: Single archive sample from the first matching file; no seasonal series

gldas.method: Modelled soil water mass in the native grid cell at the field centre
gldas.scope: Single archive sample from the first matching file; no seasonal series
